flags.parking-minimum: A proposed rule (Bill 2025-1545, still held in council) would remove required off-street parking minimums, which could free up land and construction budget for more homes [reform.status].This is not yet law [reform.status].

flags.gap-financing: Because this parcel sits in a neighborhood with a low median assessed land value, gap financing may likely be needed to make a project work, though this is just a note and not a penalty to the score [hood.median_land_psf].
flags.phfa-infill: This is a vacant infill lot in a low-value area, which may make it eligible for PHFA infill or blight-related scoring criteria, but you should confirm this against PHFA's current criteria [landuse.vacant, hood.median_land_psf].
flags.public-owner: The parcel is owned by the City, which may make acquisition easier through a public disposition process, though this is not guaranteed [owner.type].
